mapper.select: SELECT code,name,active,sort_order FROM content_types ORDER BY sort_order,code
SELECT id,code,name,active FROM cohorts ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,code,name,active FROM topics ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT type_code,topic_id FROM content_type_topics ORDER BY type_code,topic_id
SELECT t.code,t.name FROM posts p JOIN content_types t ON t.code=p.content_type_code WHERE p.id=#{value}
SELECT content_type_code AS code,type_name_snapshot AS name FROM post_publications WHERE post_id=#{value}
SELECT c.id,c.code,c.name,c.active FROM post_cohorts pc JOIN cohorts c ON c.id=pc.cohort_id WHERE pc.post_id=#{value} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT t.id,t.code,t.name,t.active FROM post_topics pt JOIN topics t ON t.id=pt.topic_id WHERE pt.post_id=#{value} ORDER BY t.id
SELECT c.id,c.code,pc.name_snapshot AS name,c.active FROM post_publication_cohorts pc JOIN cohorts c ON c.id=pc.cohort_id WHERE pc.post_id=#{value} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT t.id,t.code,pt.name_snapshot AS name,t.active FROM post_publication_topics pt JOIN topics t ON t.id=pt.topic_id WHERE pt.post_id=#{value} ORDER BY t.id
SELECT id FROM topics WHERE code=#{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET content_type_code=#{typeCode} WHERE id=#{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_publication_cohorts(post_id,cohort_id,name_snapshot) SELECT pc.post_id,c.id,c.name FROM post_cohorts pc JOIN cohorts c ON c.id=pc.cohort_id WHERE pc.post_id=#{value}
INSERT INTO post_publication_topics(post_id,topic_id,name_snapshot) SELECT pt.post_id,t.id,t.name FROM post_topics pt JOIN topics t ON t.id=pt.topic_id WHERE pt.post_id=#{value}
